data.title: Red Sea Museum Showcases 1,000-Year-Old Scale Used to Weigh Pearls
data.content:
Jeddah, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The Red Sea Museum in Historic Jeddah offers a glimpse into the history of pearl trading through an 11th-century balance scale. The set includes four bronze pans inlaid with gold and decorated with Kufic inscriptions, along with weights of various sizes, reflecting the craftsmanship of the period.
    Merchants used the balance to determine the weight of pearls, while sieves with different-sized openings helped sort them by size.
    A pearl's value, however, depended on more than its weight. Merchants also assessed its shape, color, luster, and surface quality, reflecting the attention to detail that characterized the pearl trade.
    -- SPA
